headline: Deploys now land the second they ship — no purge, no double-refresh
lede: jalfern.com was serving hours-old arcade pages after deploys because the host-hop proxy edge-cached the shell HTML and nothing invalidated it on arcade builds. The fix moves the cache policy upstream: every HTML surface now answers no-store, hashed assets immutable. Verified live on both edges with a new cachecheck harness.

notes.text: #1081 shipped: no-store on arcade root, SPA routes, and demos; immutable 1y on content-hashed assets. Jon's phone gets the current build on first load — for every future deploy, never again needing a purge.

vercel.json headers on the jalfern host do NOT apply to externally-rewritten responses — the #696 demo fix was dead config. Upstream headers do pass through the proxy: the operative fix had to live in the arcade repo.

Vercel intermittently answers hashed asset URLs with the SPA fallback (index.html@200, max-age=0) under rapid probe runs, never for browser GETs — cachecheck's asset gate is advisory by design; HTML gates stay blocking.
